title: What the venture is called
kind: app | channel | shop | tiktok-shop | dropshipping | service
category: money | food | health | productivity | family | home | uk | content | retail | other
problem: The problem or want, in one or two sentences.
gap: Why what exists today does not solve it, or what the opening is.
mvp: The smallest thing that could be sold or published
money: How it makes money: price, commission, ads, sponsorship, margin per unit.
